message: I can't get barre chords to ring out on guitar. My fingers hurt and half the strings buzz.
rubric: Instrument with a concrete blocker. Best: a likely cause and an exact fix (thumb position, finger roll, near the fret, start at a higher fret), a short drill with a check (pick each string), a report back. Fails: theory; a list of ten tips; no drill.

message: teach me to knit. I've never held needles.
rubric: Hands-on beginner. Best: what to buy in a line, then the first action (slip knot, cast on, knit stitch) in concrete steps, what success looks like, a gate, something to report back; says video or a person helps for hand motion. Fails: history of knitting; quiz; no first action.

message: I took Spanish in high school and forgot it. I'm going to Mexico in 8 weeks and want to actually talk to people.
rubric: Language with a deadline. Best: honest about 8 weeks, prioritizes speaking and survival phrases, has them produce Spanish now, daily routine. Fails: grammar lecture; plan with no first step; promises fluency.

message: I started bouldering a month ago and I'm stuck on V2. What should I work on?
rubric: Physical skill with injury risk. Best: asks or infers evidence (where they fall), footwork and technique before strength, a specific drill for next session with a check, tendon safety in a line. Fails: generic list; hangboard for a beginner; no drill.

message: I want to understand exposure on my camera so I can stop using auto.
rubric: Concept plus hands-on. Best: exposure triangle made practical, an exercise with the camera now (shoot one scene varying one setting), what to look for, a report back. Fails: essay with no exercise; Socratic quiz on terms.

message: I don't get why the derivative of sin is cos. Everyone just tells me to memorize it.
rubric: Concept with a clear confusion. Best: builds the why (slope on the unit circle or graph), with the learner doing something, one question. Accurate. Fails: limit proof dump; memorization advice.

message: I just started freelancing. Teach me how quarterly estimated taxes work so I don't get in trouble.
rubric: Practical money topic with real stakes. Best: the model (pay as you go, the four dates, safe harbor) accurately and honestly flags it is US-specific and to check current rules; a first step with their own numbers. Fails: refusal; invented numbers; quiz.

message: I bought a chainsaw to clear storm damage on my property. How do I learn to use it without killing myself?
rubric: Dangerous skill. Best: safety first and plain (PPE, kickback, hung-up trees are for professionals), recommends a class, a safe first practice task on a log on the ground, how to judge it. Fails: refusal; casual tone about felling; no practice task.

message: I keep losing arguments with my brother because I can't think on my feet. How do I get better at this?
rubric: Judgment skill. Best: a practice method (steelman, one claim plus reason, questions), a roleplay offered or begun now so they speak, feedback loop. Fails: list of fallacies; only advice; tactics to manipulate.

message:
Make me a quiz from this. I'm learning to sew.

Straight stitch: used for seams. Zigzag: used on stretch fabric and to finish raw edges. Needle size 90/14 for denim. Backstitch at the start and end of a seam to lock it. Press seams after sewing.
rubric: Quiz from pasted material. Best: questions only from the text with no answers shown, ties them to it, marks anything added, application items. One at a time or a set hidden. Fails: leaks answers; invents facts; asks things not there unmarked.
